{{Quote|The felons before you have been convicted of espionage against the Sovereign System of Geonosis. Their sentence of death is to be carried out in this arena immediately!|Sun Fac|<ref name="AotC novelization">''[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]''</ref>}}
'''Sun Fac''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] of the upper caste living in the [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].

==Biography==
Sun Fac served as [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] chief lieutenant. His position was evident in his insect-like wings, as well as the tusks at the edge of his mouth. Like most other Geonosian aristocrats, he was ruthless in his management of the wingless lower-caste [[Geonosian/Legends#Worker caste|workers]], forcing them to work in harsh conditions regardless of any dangers.

As with most Geonosians, Sun Fac was strong, despite his slender build. His tough exoskeleton protected him from physical assaults and the bouts of radiation that occasionally showered Geonosis. Sun Fac's right eye either had been sealed shut or was entirely missing. The large scar across his face suggests his missing eye was due to a battle wound.

Over time, Sun Fac, who ensured that his master's will was executed throughout Geonosis, proved to the Archduke that he was both unusually intelligent and very creative for a Geonosian.

[[File:FacSun.jpg|thumb|left|Sun Fac with [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]]]
In the events leading to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he also proved that he was as adaptable as intelligent. He was adept at playing any role required of him. Sun Fac could do it all&mdash;from supporting the Archduke to becoming a ruthless executioner.

Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Sun Fac convicted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Spy/Legends|espionage]], sentencing them to [[Death/Legends|death]] in the [[Petranaki arena|Geonosian execution arena]]. He was responsible for delivering the verdict of the Geonosian court to the two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who had come to Geonosis in an attempt to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The news was delivered to a courtroom filled with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senators]], [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] officials, [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] dignitaries, [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] members, [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] representatives, and [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] leaders who looked on while the duo protested their innocence.

[[File:Sunfacdestroyed.jpg|thumb|Sun Fac is killed by RC-1207]]
When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] invaded Geonosis, Sun Fac chose not to go into hiding with the Archduke or other high-ranking Geonosians, but instead tried to escape separately. As he reached his [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian Starfighter]] in the upper levels of a tower protruding from the hive, he was followed by [[Delta Squad/Legends|clone commandos]] who were tasked with assassinating him. Sun Fac managed to get into his starfighter, but as the ship lifted from the landing platform, Fac was shot by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] using the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System]] sniper attachment, killing him instantly and leaving his ship to crash.

==Behind the scenes==
In early drafts of the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] script, Sun Fac was referred to as "Sun Rit." This has led to confusion, as some fans believe Poggle has two aides, Sun Fac and Sun Rit, which is untrue. Poggle is seen with another aide in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. It is common to see this aide referred to as Sun Rit, though this Geonosian has no official name.

In cut and/or alternate ''Attack of the Clones'' scenes, Sun Fac was voiced by [[Christopher Truswell]].
